rfis.description: The City of Marion has issued a Further Information Request (RFI) for application 25032987, a community title division of a proposed lot at 49 Wood St South Plympton. The applicant must provide the requested information by 29 May 2026. This is likely related to supporting documentation for the community division that is dependent on parent application 25032971.

The City of Marion has issued a Further Information Request (RFI) for application 25032971, a Torrens title division creating 1 residential and 1 development lot at 49 Wood St South Plympton. The applicant must provide the requested information by 5 June 2026. The RFI was raised on 12 March 2026.

No specific due date is shown but this task is overdue since it was requested in February.

City of Tea Tree Gully RFI (20 Jan 2026): 1) Show distance between proposed crossover and existing Council tree on plan. 2) Provide species and circumference details for any regulated/significant trees on/around site. 3) Allotment frontage <9m — provide indicative dwelling plans to justify frontage shortfall. Contact: Rani Dhruva 8397 7370 rani.dhruva@cttg.sa.gov.au
